meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后,当容器代理出问题时,Claude 会依据此技能检查日志、查询会话数据库、排查挂载与认证故障,并给出对应的修复命令和排查步骤。
howto.when: 当容器失败、认证出问题,或想了解容器系统工作原理等场景时触发。

say.text: 容器不回复消息,帮我查日志和数据库
say.note: Claude 会检查会话 DB 和日志定位问题

say.text: 看看有没有重复的 NanoClaw 实例在跑
say.note: Claude 会用 ps 命令检查进程

say.text: 给我讲讲容器系统是怎么工作的
say.note: Claude 会依据架构概述解释消息流

howto.what_en: After installing, when container agent issues arise, Claude follows this guide to check logs, query session DBs, troubleshoot mounts and authentication, and provide repair commands and steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when containers fail, authentication has problems, or when the user wants to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The container isn't replying — check logs and DBs.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect session DBs and logs.

say_en.text: Check if two NanoClaw instances are running.
say_en.note: Claude uses ps to find duplicate processes.

say_en.text: Explain how the container system works.
say_en.note: Claude describes the architecture and message flow.
